tr.title: Eski bir dost
tr.subtitle: Telefon
tr.body:
Ürün yayında. Telefon çalıyor, arayan Frank.

"Eski bir dostuma senin üründen bahsettim. İşine yarayabileceğini düşünüyor. Bir görüşme ayarladım. Hazırlıklı git."

Kapatıyor.

en.title: An old friend
en.subtitle: Phone
en.body:
The product is live. The phone rings. It's Frank.

"I told an old friend of mine about what you've built. He thinks it might be useful to him. I've set up a meeting. Go in prepared."

He hangs up.
en.expire_note: The person Frank introduced spoke to somebody else.

_repair_note: the option is called "go to Sales" and the button only dismissed the card. One of the seven FRANK_UNWIRED.md §5 names
_r8a_note: A non-critical interrupt is demotable (§13.2), and a demoted card lands on the desk with a clock — which is the only reason paper is a safe floor for I4. So it carries the paper trio even though it usually renders as an interrupt.
_port_note: Tagged `critical` — which in this engine means the sweep proposes it, not the weighted pool. It is a `one_shot` with a deterministic condition (the product is live) and it is a gateway beat, not pool colour; leaving it to a draw meant some runs simply never got it, with nothing to point at.
